ios.s1: Keep the watch close to the iPhone with Bluetooth on. If it is still connected to another phone, disconnect it there first. It shows up in the list below.
ios.s2: Unbind it from Huawei Health first, or the watch will refuse this app.
ios.s3: On the first connect, keep the watch awake, accept the prompt on its screen, then tap Pair on the iPhone.

android.s1: Unbind the watch from Huawei Health first, or the watch will refuse this app.
android.s2: Pair it in Android Bluetooth settings, or tap "Scan nearby devices" below to find it.
android.s3: On the first connect, keep the watch awake and accept the prompt on its screen.

hint.busy: Could not connect to the watch. If it is still connected to another phone or app (Huawei Health, or JoyoFit on another phone), disconnect it there first. Keep the watch awake and close to this phone, then tap Retry.
hint.noWatchIos: Watch not found. If it is still connected to another phone, disconnect it there first. Make sure the watch is on and close to this phone, then tap Refresh.
hint.noWatchScan: No watch found nearby. If it is still connected to another phone or app (Huawei Health, or JoyoFit on another phone), disconnect it there first. Make sure the watch is on and close to this phone, then scan again.
hint.notPaired: Android has no Bluetooth pairing with this watch (it was removed, or the watch refused to pair again). Open Android's Bluetooth settings and pair the watch, then tap Try again. If the watch does not show up there, remove this phone once in the watch's own Bluetooth settings. JoyoFit deletes nothing.

silent.short: The watch connected over Bluetooth but does not answer. What to try is under More, Watch.
silent.title: The watch connected but does not answer
silent.intro: JoyoFit reached the watch over Bluetooth, but the watch did not reply to the first request. Usually another app or phone is using it. Try these one at a time, then tap Retry.

step.release: Disconnect the watch from Huawei Health and from any other phone, then close that app completely.
step.forgetIos: On the iPhone, open Settings > Bluetooth, tap the (i) icon next to the watch, then choose Forget This Device.
step.restart: Restart the watch, wait until its screen is fully on, then bring it close to the phone.
step.bluetooth: Turn the phone's Bluetooth off and on again, then try to connect.

silent.reportHelp: If it still fails, send a report. It holds the latest Bluetooth log, without Bluetooth addresses or the serial number.

limits.optimized: Android can stop JoyoFit when the screen is off or the app is closed to save battery. That is a common reason a watch disconnects by itself. Let JoyoFit run without battery limits.
limits.restricted: JoyoFit's background battery use is Restricted, so Android shuts it down when the screen is off and the watch disconnects. Open the app settings, choose Battery, then Unrestricted.
limits.vendor: {{maker}} phones also keep a list of apps that may start by themselves (auto-start). Turn JoyoFit on there too, or the watch can still disconnect with the battery setting right.
limits.error: That settings screen did not open on this phone. Open Settings, Apps, JoyoFit, then Battery.

bonded.forgetMessage: This deletes the watch's authentication key from this phone and removes the watch from your list. Health data already stored stays. The next connection is a first pairing and has to be confirmed on the watch. The Android Bluetooth pairing does not change.
bonded.forgetMessageIos: This deletes the watch's authentication key from this phone and removes the watch from your list. Health data already stored stays. JoyoFit cannot remove the watch's side: to use Huawei Health again, also reset or unbind the watch (watch Settings > System > Reset, or remove the phone in the watch's own Bluetooth settings), then pair it in Huawei Health. If the watch is listed in the iPhone's Settings > Bluetooth, tap the (i) icon and choose Forget This Device.
bonded.systemConnected: Already connected to this iPhone. Tap Connect to use it here.
bonded.notInReach: Not in reach. If it is on another phone, disconnect it there first.
bonded.notPairedRemembered: Remembered by JoyoFit, but Android no longer lists it as paired. Connect uses the saved address and asks Android to pair again if needed.

bind.title: Pair this watch with this phone?

bind.messageAndroid: This watch is not paired with this phone yet. A watch keeps one phone pairing, so continuing replaces the pairing with your other phone or app (Huawei Health, or JoyoFit on another phone), which will have to pair again. You will then confirm on the watch.
bind.lostAndroid: JoyoFit was paired with this watch, but the watch no longer knows this phone: another app or phone paired it again while JoyoFit was not connected. Often that is Huawei Health: while it is enabled, it reconnects to the watch and pairs it again by itself, even when you are not using it. Disable or uninstall Huawei Health first (Settings, Apps, Huawei Health, Disable or Uninstall), then continue and confirm on the watch. Unpairing the watch in Huawei Health instead may reset the watch.
bind.lostIos: JoyoFit was paired with this watch, but the watch no longer knows this iPhone: another app or phone paired it again while JoyoFit was not connected, for example Huawei Health. Stop that app or phone from connecting to the watch first, then continue and confirm on the watch.

support.title: Help support your watch
support.intro: JoyoFit is tested on the Huawei Watch Fit 4 Pro. Other Huawei and Honor watches are experimental. If something does not work, connect once, then send a report. It lists what your watch answered on its last connect, without Bluetooth addresses or the serial number.
support.copied: The full report is on your clipboard. On GitHub, say what works and what does not, then paste the report into the Log field.

Whether the watch accepts a face that Huawei did not sign is not known. If it refuses, the exact status code it returned is shown here and in the log.

Whether the watch accepts a face that Huawei did not sign is not known. If it refuses, the exact status code it returned is shown here and in the log.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.ant: ANT+ is not supported (it needs ANT hardware). Use a Bluetooth sensor.
notes.huawei: A Huawei watch cannot take an external strap. A strap is used by workouts recorded on the phone.

gpsAssist.body: Precise location is not allowed yet. Without it the phone cannot lend its position to the watch during an outdoor run, so the watch's GPS can take several minutes to lock. Location is only used during a workout and is not stored.

agps.title: Satellite data (A-GPS)
agps.details: Your watch uses satellite data to find its GPS position quickly. The data is good for about 7 days. If your watch asks for the Broadcom kind, JoyoFit downloads it from Broadcom's public server, with no account, and gives it to the watch. Other kinds are prepared only by Huawei's own app; JoyoFit never sends the watch anything it did not ask for.
agps.detailsLab: An experiment you turned on in Settings > About & advanced: your watch asks for the HW_AGNSS kind, and JoyoFit sends satellite data that JoyoFit's server builds from public broadcast data (IGS/BKG), not from Huawei. It is good for about 4 hours. The watch does not check this data and no watch has been shown to accept it. Note how long the watch's GPS takes to find its position before and after. If the watch's GPS misbehaves, turn the experiment off; a factory reset recovers the watch.
agps.detailsPgnss: An experiment you turned on in Settings > About & advanced: your watch asks for the HW_PGNSS_PRED kind, and JoyoFit sends six files of predicted satellite orbits for 3 days that JoyoFit's server computes from public data, not from Huawei. The watch does not check this data and no watch has been shown to accept it. Note how long the watch's GPS takes to find its position before and after. If the watch's GPS misbehaves, turn the experiment off; a factory reset recovers the watch.
